metadata.description: devpowers — a product line of Claude Code plugins by umar-s: research, loop engineering, and more. One marketplace, individual plugin repos.

plugins.name: research-pipeline
plugins.description: Multi-phase parallel research pipeline — decompose topic → research aspects in parallel → synthesize → quality gate → grounded report. Includes source tiering, slop detection, git-based checkpointing, and WebSearch/Exa backends.

plugins.name: loop-foundry
plugins.description: End-to-end loop-engineering pipeline: applicability filter → YouTrack backlog triage → LOOP_SPECs → gap analysis → runner generation → staged autonomy ladder (shadow → gated → autonomous) with measured approval rates. Refuses to build loops where the approach does not apply.

plugins.name: co-rar
plugins.description: Design and critique frame for systems where AI orchestrates execution and quality is held by a continuous adversarial loop — anti-spam/anti-fraud, warmup and deliverability, agentic pipelines, codeless backends, systems that must mutate under environmental pressure instead of decaying. Companion skill for loop-foundry's statistical-gate loops.

plugins.name: voxscribe
plugins.description: Russian-first audio/video → readable text via faster-whisper on CPU. Three modes: lecture (transcribe + paragraph stitching → .md), dialogue (transcribe + pyannote diarization + sbert punctuation → speaker turns with em-dashes), folder (list files and fan out to parallel subagents). Auto-extracts wav from video via ffmpeg, idempotent, atomic writes, no-speech guard.

plugins.name: premortem
plugins.description: Premortem advisor — finds the concrete ways a plan could fail before commitment: multi-agent silent scan, mitigation triplets, history snapshots, reverse-premortem. Klein 2007 + Kahneman outside view.

plugins.name: task-flow
plugins.description: Three skills, one pipeline: decompose → task → ci-gate. decompose cuts an epic, feature or spec into dependency-linked tasks with a DoD, story points, a graph and parallelism waves; task runs one ticket end-to-end — ingest → 2× premortem → TDD → adversarial code-review → conditional security-review → live verify → close; ci-gate scaffolds the deterministic merge floor into any GitLab/GitHub repo — portable gitleaks secret-scan, tool-agnostic migration-guard, protected-branch.

plugins.name: md2pdf
plugins.description: Markdown → presentable PDF without LaTeX: pandoc → house-style HTML template (GitHub typography, IBM Plex, A4, compact margins) → headless Chromium print-to-pdf. Cyrillic works everywhere; pure-Arabic lines inside quotes are right-aligned mushaf-style for bilingual ayat/translation documents. Wide tables stay inside the page margin, with per-column widths settable from Markdown.
